500071.name: Branč

500232.name: Golianovo

500313.name: Hruboňovo

500372.name: Jelenec
500372.note: The mayor's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' of 05.05.2026 (on https://www.jelenec.sk/obecny-urad/volby-a-referenda/referendum-2026/) names only the polling room of each of the 2 okrsky, not their territory; the municipality has a single part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn.

500470.name: Lúčnica nad Žitavou
500470.note: The Referendum 2026 page lists only the two okrsky commissions' minutes; no okrsky document live or in the Internet Archive.

500828.name: Topoľčianky
500828.note: The mayor's 'Volebné okrsky a volebné miestnosti' for the referendum of 4 July 2026 (dated 22.04.2026, posted 23.04.2026) sets two okrsky but gives only their polling stations (Stredná sála and Malá zasadačka, both in the Dom kultúry a služieb, Hlavná 114), no streets; no street list for the referendum on its page or the notice board (items 1700–1760 enumerated). With one part and both stations in one building the okrsky cannot be placed. The street list of 24.07.2026 is for the elections of 24 October 2026, not this vote.

500887.name: Veľké Zálužie
500887.note: The referendum 2026 page and notice board hold the announcement of the time and place (Spoločenský dom, okrsok 3 in the form) but no okrsky document with streets; the 8.7.2026 okrsky decision is for the later elections of 24.10.2026. The Internet Archive (web.archive.org, incl. the CDX API) refused connections throughout (about 45 minutes, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

500941.name: Výčapy-Opatovce
500941.note: The only okrsky document found (Utvorenie volebných okrskov for the referendum of 4 July 2026, 05.05.2026) creates 2 okrsky with both polling rooms in the hall of the Kultúrny dom, Opatovská 204/1, without saying which addresses belong to which okrsok (the voters are split about equally, evidently by voter list); the other votes' pages (live and in the Internet Archive) list no okrsky document. No rules can be written.

501085.name: Čalovec
501085.note: The live notice board (searched in full for 'okrskov') keeps okrsky notices only for 2022, 2023 (NR SR), 2024 (president, EP) and October 2026; for this vote it has at most the notice on delegating okrsková komisia members, without okrsky. The Internet Archive's captures of calovec.sk begin in 2021 and its notice-board files (obsah…) of 2021–2026 include no okrsky notice for this vote.

501115.name: Svätý Peter
501115.note: No okrsky document of this vote found: the municipality's website (svatypeter.eu) keeps election pages only from the 2022 elections on (okrsky notices of 2022-11 referendum 2023, NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024); its Referendum 2026 page has only the commission minutes, and the notice board shows no 2026 referendum okrsky notice.

501123.name: Dulovce
501123.note: The referendum 2026 page holds the calling, information on voting, e-mail addresses and the minutes of both okrsky; no okrsky document.

501140.name: Hurbanovo
501140.note: The referendum 2026 decision (21.04.2026, č. 2072-9227/2026) lists the 8 okrsky only by polling station (two in Bohatá, three in Hurbanovo), with no streets; okrsky cannot be drawn from it. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

501166.name: Imeľ
501166.note: No okrsky document for the referendum of 4 July 2026 found. The live page 'Referendum 2026' (and its 2026-04-22 Internet Archive capture) lists the announcement (Rozhodnutie 60/2026), voter information, delivery addresses and OVK minutes, but no okrsky document. The okrsky document 'Volebné okrsky v obci Imeľ' (editor-17-83-sk_5.pdf) is on the page of the municipal elections of 24 October 2026, i.e. for that later vote, so it is not used.

501182.name: Kameničná
501182.note: The referendum 2026 page lists decision, info, delegation, minutes; no okrsky document.

501239.name: Marcelová
501239.note: Found the vote's 'Informácia o vytvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností' on the website. The document gives each okrsok only its polling station (okrsky 1 and 2 both in the Kultúrny dom, súp. č. 1161; okrsok 3 in the Materská škola, Námestie slobody 1395), with no streets or parts; the municipality has 3 okrsky but only 2 parts (Marcelová, Krátke Kesy), and two stations share one building, so the okrsky cannot be placed from it.

501280.name: Nesvady
501280.note: The primátor's decision of 5. 5. 2026 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností pre Referendum 2026' gives each okrsok only its polling station, all four in the part Nesvady (Obchodná 21, Obchodná 23, Novozámocká cesta 21 / Komenského 21, Športová), and names no streets or parts; the town has 4 parts (Aňala, Aňalské Záhrady, Nesvady, Sady) but the stations are not one per part, so no part can be inferred. No street list ('Volebné okrsky s vymedzením ich územného obvodu', as published in 2022-2024) is on the 2026 pages or the notice board; the later decision of 15. 7. 2026 for the elections of 24 October 2026 likewise lists only the polling stations.

501395.name: Bátorove Kosihy
501395.note: The website keeps only 2026 election files; the only okrsky document found (for the municipal elections of October 2026) names 3 okrsky all in the cultural house no. 1263 with no addresses per okrsok, and the village is a single part with no streets, so no rules can be drawn even from it. The Internet Archive (online) holds no okrsky document of this vote (its 2018-2020 captures of the elections page files are candidate lists and voter information).

501417.name: Zemianska Olča
501417.note: The notice board (live, all pages, and as archived since 2017) has okrsky documents only for the referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, the presidential and EP elections 2024 and the municipal elections of October 2026; none for this vote.

501425.name: Zlatná na Ostrove
501425.note: The website (elections section, full-text search) has no okrsky document of the referendum 2026 (its page has no okrsky announcement); the Internet Archive was offline. Later announcements (2018, 2023, 2024) use súp. č. 0-436 + Veľký Lél / 437-992 + Horná Zlatná.

501522.name: Veľký Meder
501522.note: No okrsky document of the referendum of July 2026 found on the website (search and notice board); Internet Archive offline.

501573.name: Gabčíkovo
501573.note: The city's document for this vote ("Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností pre Referendum, ktoré sa bude konať 4.7.2026", 04.5.2026) creates okrsky 1-4 but names for each only its polling station, all four in the same building (ZŠ L. Amadého s VJM, Komenského 1081/1, B budova, different classrooms); it lists no streets, house numbers or parts. Gabčíkovo has a single part and k.ú., so the okrsky cannot be placed by part either (prompt: station-only documents are usable only where okrsky equal parts with stations in different parts). No other document of the city (live elections pages 2020-2026, archived Joomla site 2017-2022) lists the okrsky's streets.

501581.name: Holice
501581.note: The obec's website (www.obecholice.sk -> www.gelle.sk; the old www.holice.sk is a parked domain) keeps on its notice board (current and archive by year 2017-2026) okrsky documents only for the NR SR election of 2023-09-30 and the EP election of 2024-06-08; for this vote it has none (for 2017 only an 'Informácie pre voliča' DOCX, for 2026 referendum items without an okrsky decision). The Internet Archive CDX API timed out and then refused connections for about 15 minutes; the availability API shows only a 2019 homepage capture of gelle.sk, which could not be opened.

501590.name: Horná Potôň
501590.note: Referendum 2026: only the information on voting rights (item 410) and e-mail address; no okrsky document. The current site's elections section (live and archived records, categories NR SR 2020, NR SR 2023, referendum 2023, prezident 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026) holds only voter information, e-mail addresses and minutes for these votes; the only okrsky document is "N-9-volebné okrsky.doc" of 2022 (3 okrsky, places only), which is another vote's.

501611.name: Dolný Štál
501611.note: The referendum 2026 post (live, and archived 2026-04-21) links only the announcement, voter information and the commissions' records; no okrsky document for the referendum found.

501638.name: Hviezdoslavov
501638.note: The referendum 2026 document 'Vytvorenie okrskov' gives only okrsok 1 and 2 with polling rooms (both in the same school), no addresses or súpisné čísla; one part only, so okrsky cannot be drawn. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

501662.name: Janíky
501662.note: Okrsky documents on janiky.sk exist only for the National Council election of 2023 (evt_file 3473 + notice 576sk); the sections for this vote (live and archived) hold no okrsky document, and a 2023 document is not valid for this vote.

501719.name: Kútniky
501719.note: The website (a Joomla site listing its notices as PDFs on the home page) never posted an okrsky document except for the 2022 elections (and 2026): the archived home pages of 2021-2026 list for the referendum 2023, NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024 and the referendum 2026 only voter information, e-mail notices and commission minutes; the Internet Archive has nothing of 2017-2020 elections and the live site keeps only 2025-2026 notices.

501735.name: Lehnice
501735.note: The municipality (2 okrsky, 5 parts, no streets) publishes no utvorenie volebných okrskov with their territory on its website, live or archived; the referendum 2026 documents archived (voter information, questions, decision) contain no okrsky; no okrsky page found.

501743.name: Lúč na Ostrove
501743.note: The obec's Voľby page (live, and as the Internet Archive kept it in 2019 and 2022) has a category "Referendum 2026" but no decision on the okrsky and polling stations for this vote: only the announcement of the vote, the e-mail address for delegating commission members, the Ministry's information for voters (generic, no okrsky) and, for elections, candidate lists or commission minutes. The live notice board is empty and none of its archived documents (old e_download.php and data/uredni_deska files, file_storage downloads in the CDX) concerns the okrsky. The only okrsky decision the website has is the one for the municipal and regional elections of 24 October 2026 (download.php?file=4486d01c|545), which is not this vote's. The Internet Archive answered. A web search for the okrsky of Lúč na Ostrove found nothing else.

501808.name: Nový Život
501808.note: The website's pages of the votes (news items 'Voľby …', 'Referendum 2026') link no okrsky document of the 2026 referendum vote (only results, minutes, voter information); the notice board keeps only current items; the only okrsky document on the site is that of the elections of 24 October 2026. The Internet Archive's web.archive.org refused every connection for over 30 minutes (only the availability API answered), so no archived pages or documents could be read.
tried: https://www.novyzivot.sk/evt_file.php?file=2288 … 2330 (unlinked files of spring 2026, by file name)

501824.name: Okoč
501824.note: The referendum 2026 page (archived 2026-04-23; gone live) links 'Rozhodnutie o vyhlásení R_ volebné okrsky a volebné miestnosti', which is only the Okresný úrad Dunajská Streda's circular to all municipalities (asking mayors to set okrsky by 7 May 2026), not the mayor's decision; no okrsky document found.
tried: https://www.okoc.sk/e_download.php?file=data/uredni_deska/obsah1_1.pdf … obsah400_1.pdf (every file of the notice board, 244 found, none on okrsky)

501859.name: Orechová Potôň
501859.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The current website (since about 2024) has no elections page; its notice board (all 10 pages) lists for elections only the 2026 municipal/regional notices (candidates, commission, obvody). The Internet Archive's CDX of orechovapoton.sk (2016–2026) lists the old site's election pages (information for voters, e-mail addresses, the 2018 page stating 'Počet okrskov: 2') and result records, but no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' or list of streets per okrsok. The Internet Archive was offline at times but answered after retries.

501921.name: Topoľníky
501921.note: No okrsky document of this vote found. The current website (topolniky.sk, new CMS) shows on its notice board only the okrsky of the elections of 24 October 2026; the old WordPress site's pages for this vote, as far as the Internet Archive kept them (2019-2020 NRSR voter information, the 2023 referendum page, 2022 candidate lists), carry no okrsky notice; the only okrsky announcement found is that of the National Council election of 2023.

502006.name: Vrakúň
502006.note: The live site keeps only the October 2026 okrsky notice (okrsok 1 časť obce Vrakúň, okrsok 2 časť obce Nekyje na Ostrove). The Internet Archive's captures of vrakun.sk (CDX 2017–2026) hold no okrsky document of 2017, 2018, 2019 or 2020 and none for 2024 (the 2024 elections pages and the one PDF retrievable hold only e-mail notices; other captures failed to load).  The referendum 2026 page (live and archived 2026-04-23) links no okrsky document.

502014.name: Vydrany
502014.note: The referendum 2026 page links '20260618-Referendum-Utvorenie_volebny_okrskov_a_urcenie_volebny_miestnosti.pdf', but that PDF holds only its title (one page, no other content in its content stream or annotations). Vydrany's okrsky documents of other votes (e.g. EP 2024) name only the two polling stations (Kultúrny dom, Námestie Svätého Štefana 534; Budova základných škôl, Vydrany 613) without any division of the addresses, and the municipality has a single part and no streets, so the two okrsky cannot be drawn from them. The Internet Archive CDX returned nothing / did not answer.

502022.name: Zlaté Klasy
502022.note: The municipality has an elections page for each vote (live and in the Internet Archive), but none of them links an okrsky document (they hold the information for voters, delegation forms and the okrsky commissions' minutes). The only okrsky document found, "rozdelenie ulíc do okrskov" (evt_file.php?file=7010), is on the page of the 2022 municipal and regional elections, a vote not among these.

502642.name: Plášťovce
502642.note: The notice board's referendum 2026 item holds only the President's decision calling the referendum and voter information; no okrsky document. Earlier archived notices could not be checked: The Internet Archive (web.archive.org CDX API) stayed offline (HTTP 503 / connection failures) for over 20 minutes of retries with pauses, so archived pages of earlier votes could not be searched.

502693.name: Pukanec
502693.note: The website has no elections section; the notice board lists only current items, the per-vote pages found (presidential 2024, referendum 2026) are gone (404) and the referendum 2023 page no longer links documents. The host also rate-limits (HTTP 429). Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

502821.name: Tekovské Lužany
502821.note: Every okrsky notice on the website (president 2019 of 30.01.2019, referendum 2023, NR SR 2023 of 22.06.2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026 of 24.04.2026) only gives the number of okrsky (3) and their polling stations (Obecný úrad SNP 43, Základná škola J. A. Komenského 37, bývalá MŠ Družstevná 87), not which streets vote where; the municipality has a single part, so no okrsok can be inferred from its station. No 2017 or 2018 okrsky document is on the site. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

502987.name: Želiezovce
502987.note: For the referendum of 4 July 2026 the elections page lists only the report on the vote and turnout; no okrsky document live or in the Internet Archive.

503185.name: Gbelce
503185.note: The website has no elections section; the notice board and news list only items from 2024 on (the EP 2024 item is the only one with an okrsky document; the referendum 2026 item has results only). Host rate-limits (HTTP 429). Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

503282.name: Komjatice
503282.note: The live referendum 2026 page (komjatice.sk/dokumenty/volby/referendum-2026/) lists the president's decision, voter information, forms, the per-voter 'Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania referenda' (names only okrsok 1, staré KINO, no streets), data-protection notice and OVK minutes; no document forming the okrsky for 4 July 2026. The 2026 municipal-election document of 2026-07-27 is for another vote.

503321.name: Lipová
503321.note: The current website keeps election documents only for the October 2026 elections (and results of the 2026 referendum); no okrsky document of this vote and no older election pages. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

503401.name: Mužla
503401.note: The live referendum 2026 page lists only the decision calling the referendum, voter information and an e-mail address; no okrsky document (the 2026 okrsky files on the site are of the elections of 24 October 2026).

503452.name: Palárikovo
503452.note: The referendum 2026 page and the notice board list only the information on voting rights and the commissions' minutes; no okrsky document for the referendum of 4 July 2026 found (site search for 'okrskov' and 'referendum'). The Internet Archive was unreachable.

503568.name: Svodín
503568.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The live elections page has only the 2026 municipal documents (with the 2026 okrsky list); the 2026 referendum notice has only the commission records; the site search for 'okrsk' finds nothing older. The Internet Archive's captures of the old (WordPress) and new site's election pages and notices (2017, 2018, 2019, referendum 2023, NR SR 2023) list voters' information, postal vote, e-mail and council-size notices, but no okrsky document, and its CDX of svodin.sk has no okrsky file.

503614.name: Tvrdošovce
503614.note: No okrsky document with streets found. The municipality's election pages (old site, live at archiv.tvrdosovce.sk/informacie/volby, 2013-2024; new site tvrdosovce.sk/volby.html from 2026) give for 2017 and 2023 only the polling stations of the 4 okrsky (ZŠ Nová cesta; Obecný/Kultúrny dom for 2 and 3; MŠ Hlboká), with no streets, and for the other votes no okrsky notice at all; the Internet Archive's index adds nothing. With one part and 4 okrsky the split cannot be inferred.

503649.name: Zemné
503649.note: The Referendum 2026 page lists only voter information and the two okrsky commissions' records; no okrsky notice.

503835.name: Jelka
503835.note: The 2026 referendum page has the President's decision, voter information and minutes, no okrsky document. Jelka publishes for its votes only the number of okrsky and their polling stations (e.g. https://jelka.sk/wp-content/uploads/dokumenty/volby-do-narodnej-rady-sr/doc02890320230807110021-9h1175.pdf for 2023 and https://jelka.sk/wp-content/uploads/dokumenty/volby-prezidenta/doc03233820240130132240-197baj.pdf for 2024: okrsky 1 and 2 in the same building on Školská, okrsok 3 at Hlavná 760), never which streets vote where; with 3 okrsky in one part of the municipality they cannot be turned into rules.

503991.name: Selice
503991.note: The referendum document (č. 187/2026, 7 May 2026) only creates okrsky 1 and 2 and names their polling station, the same Kultúrny dom, Čsl. Armády 913/85, for both; it assigns no streets or parts, and the municipality has one part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it.

504009.name: Sereď
504009.note: The referendum 2026 notices say only that 13 okrsky are formed; no document listing their streets was found on the website (elections page, notices, notice board) or in the Internet Archive.

504025.name: Šaľa
504025.note: No okrsky document for the referendum of 2026: its article (archived 2026-04-30) lists only the decision calling it and the voters' information. The town's website answers 'Access Forbidden' to our requests, so only Internet Archive copies could be used.

504068.name: Tešedíkovo
504068.note: Found 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností pre referendum, konané dňa 4.7.2026' of 23.4.2026 (obsah1417_1.pdf), but it names only the three polling stations. Every okrsky document Tešedíkovo published (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026, municipal/regional 2026) gives each of its 3 okrsky only its polling station (Dom kultúry č. 860; MŠ č. 153; Školská jedáleň ZŠ č. 974), never which houses vote where. The municipality has one part and no streets in the register, so the okrsky cannot be placed or inferred from the stations (the prompt's part-inference needs as many parts as okrsky).

504106.name: Trstice
504106.note: The only okrsky statement for the referendum of 4 July 2026 is in 'Referendum 2026' (notice-board item 405, posted 21.5.2026, https://www.trstice.sk/e_download.php?file=/data/uredni_deska/obsah390_1.pdf, page 3): '3 volebné okrsky v obci Trstice', polling stations 1. Obecný úrad č. 667, 2. Komunitný dom č. 1322, 3. Základná škola č. 647, with no house numbers or territory. Trstice has a single part and no streets (all addresses are súpisné čísla), so a list of polling stations alone cannot be turned into rules (3 okrsky, 1 part). The radio announcements on the site start in May 2026 and none before 4 July 2026 concerns the referendum; the house-number ranges (1–500, 501–1000, 1001–) appear only in the announcement for the elections of 24 October 2026. Every item of the official notice board (úradná tabuľa, items 1–444, 2016–2026, incl. the items migrated from the old Joomla site) was listed by id and every election item opened; the Internet Archive (CDX of trstice.sk, old site trstice.sk/sk/aktuality/…) was searched for election pages and radio announcements (hlásenie miestneho rozhlasu) around the vote; the IA was slow and often refused connections, but the pages listed in tried were retrieved.

504122.name: Veľká Mača
504122.note: Veľká Mača's okrsky documents (2023 NRSR, 2024 president, 2024 EP, 2026 municipal/regional) only create 2 okrsky and name their polling stations, both in the same building (Obecný úrad, Sereďská 137: zasadačka / sobášna sieň); none assigns streets or house numbers. The municipality has one part and no street names, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from stations. No 2017–2022 documents are on the site and the Internet Archive has no captures of velkamaca.sk for 2017–2022.

504131.name: Veľké Úľany
504131.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (2024 presidential, 2026) give only the four polling stations, all in the same part (Veľké Úľany, Hlavná 579/8 and 578/9), with no streets or parts per okrsok; no document with streets is on the website, and the Internet Archive keeps only the old frames site (no election documents for 2017–2023).

504238.name: Borský Mikuláš
504238.note: No notice of the 2026 referendum okrsky found on the website or in the Internet Archive.

504254.name: Brestovec
504254.note: This vote's document was found, but The okrsky documents of 2023 (referendum, NR SR), 2024 (president, EP) and the 2026 referendum give only the two polling stations (zasadačka OcÚ/KD Brestovec 189/273; kancelária PD Poriadie 412) and no osady, house numbers or streets; Brestovec is one part without streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from them.

504351.name: Gbely
504351.note: The Referendum 2026 page lists the decision of the President, voter information, delegation notice and the results/zápisnice of okrsky 1 and 2, but no okrsky document. The city's other okrsky documents (referendum 2023: 2 okrsky; municipal 2026: 4 okrsky) give only the polling station, all in ZŠ s MŠ Gbely, Pionierska 697, with no streets, which cannot be turned into rules. No street list of the okrsky was found on the website or by web search.

504416.name: Jablonica
504416.note: The referendum 2026 page lists no okrsky document (the vote's announcement and voter information only). The okrsky documents of this municipality (2015/16, 2022, 2024) define the two okrsky by street names (okrsok 1: Červenej armády, Dúbrava, Hurbanova, …; okrsok 2: Bernolákova, Bosý Jarok, Brezie, …), but the address register has no streets for Jablonica (all 946 addresses are without a street, one part, one k.ú.), so no rule can select those streets and the document cannot be turned into valid rules without guessing.

504742.name: Radošovce
504742.note: The referendum page of radosovce.sk (Referendum 2026, posted 23 April 2026) has the president's decision, the voter information, the e-mail address for OVK delegations and the OVK minutes of okrsky 1 and 2, but no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' for the referendum of 4 July 2026; nor does the notice board, the site search or the Internet Archive's 2026 captures. The okrsky documents on the site are those of 2023 NRSR, 2024 presidential, 2024 EP and 2026 municipal elections (Radošovce súp. č. 1–316; Vieska and Radošovce súp. č. 317–475).

504769.name: Rohožník
504769.note: No document of this vote assigning addresses to okrsky found live or in the Internet Archive. 504815.name: Skalica

507636.name: Šúrovce

507709.name: Veľké Kostoľany

507857.name: Častá

507989.name: Svätý Jur

508519.name: Čerín

509124.name: Závadka nad Hronom

509230.name: Korňa
509230.note: The website's news on the 2020 NR SR and 2024 presidential elections link only voter information, records of results and the e-mail addresses; the site search finds an okrsky announcement only for the 2022 elections. 509302.name: Nesluša

509485.name: Staškov
509485.note: The okrsky decision Staškov publishes (referendum 2026, 05.05.2026) only creates 2 okrsky with rooms in the same building (vestibul / spoločenská sála OÚ) and gives no territory; the register has one part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn.

509493.name: Svrčinovec
509493.note: No okrsky document of the referendum of 4 July 2026 on svrcinovec.sk: the site search (okrsk, okrskov, volby, voľby, referendum, urcenie) finds only the elections pages of 2017, 2018 and the 2019 presidential election. The archived news page "Referendum 2026" links only the president's decision and the information for voters. The decisions of 2017 and 2019 that exist define the okrsky only by kopanice names absent from the register, so they could not be transcribed either. Svrčinovec has no streets and one part (Svrčinovec); every address is a súpisné číslo. The okrsky documents of 2017 and of the presidential election of 2019 (identical lists) define the 3 okrsky only by kopanice/osady names: okrsok 1 U Jurištov, U Skorky, U Mišov, U Katraka, U Krišice, U Hlaváča, U Berka, U Švoľka, U Cyprichov, Pod Grapami, U Puraša, U Privarčáka; okrsok 2 U Kupky, Pod bučky a valy, U Vajdíka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka, U Matiaška, U Blažkov; okrsok 3 U Liščáka, Škradné, Potok a Bordža (polling stations: kultúrny dom, ZŠ, kaplnka na Závrší). None of these names is a street, part or k.ú. of the register, and no source gives their house numbers. Seven of them (U Skorky, U Krišice, U Švoľka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka) are not in ZBGIS geographic names (inspirews.skgeodesy.sk GN) or OSM at all, and the located ones of okrsky 1 and 2 are interleaved all over the village (e.g. Pod Grapami (1) west of Matiaškovci (2), Vajdíkovci (2) beside Jurištovci (1)). Assigning each register address to the nearest located osada gives 691/199/162 addresses for okrsky 1/2/3, against 1199/1294/311 voters on the roll in 2018 (okrsok 2 should be the largest), so the split between okrsky 1 and 2 (in particular of the village centre) cannot be drawn without guessing. Only okrsok 3 (Závršie, Škradné, Potok, separated from the centre) would be clear.

509515.name: Vysoká nad Kysucou

509523.name: Zákopčie

518662.name: Očová

518689.name: Pliešovce

518913.name: Sverepec

519197.name: Giraltovce

520331.name: Kamenica nad Cirochou

520829.name: Stakčín

521299.name: Čaňa

521493.name: Jasov

521523.name: Kecerovce

521639.name: Kysak

The website itself refuses connections from here.

521655.name: Malá Ida

521671.name: Medzev

The Internet Archive, where they might be kept, refused connections (offline) during the search.

521931.name: Rozhanovce

521973.name: Seňa

522376.name: Budkovce

522791.name: Moravany

523101.name: Strážske

523259.name: Vinné

523488.name: Hôrka
523488.note: The website keeps only a 'VOĽBY 2026' page (October 2026 elections); its notice board shows only current items and the site map and search show no earlier election page or okrsky document. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

523518.name: Hranovnica

523631.name: Liptovská Teplička

523798.name: Rakúsy

523933.name: Štrba

524395.name: Fintice

525146.name: Sabinov

525618.name: Dedinky

525634.name: Dobšiná

525677.name: Gemerské Teplice

525685.name: Gemerský Sad

526002.name: Muránska Huta

526258.name: Sirk

526282.name: Slavošovce

526291.name: Stratená

526576.name: Hnilčík

526746.name: Hromoš

526975.name: Podolínec

528293.name: Čierna nad Tisou

528463.name: Krišovská Liesková

528471.name: Kuzmice

528625.name: Nový Ruskov

528676.name: Parchovany

528706.name: Rad

528722.name: Sečovce

529133.name: Sečovská Polianka

529176.name: Soľ

529222.name: Vechec

529265.name: Zámutov

529346.name: Bratislava-Nové Mesto
529346.note: The live elections page (banm.sk/28691/volby) now shows only the October 2026 elections (their own okrsky lists, not usable for the referendum); no referendum 2026 okrsky document found live or by web search; the Internet Archive (after several refused connections) lists no referendum file of data.moderneobce.sk/data/uploads/banm.sk.

542733.name: Bošany
542733.note: The Referendum 2026 page holds only the minutes, data-protection notice and delegation notice; no okrsky. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

542938.name: Horné Obdokovce
542938.note: For the referendum of 4 July 2026 the website has only the notice on the conditions of the right to vote (Podmienky-prava-hlasovat-v-referende.pdf); the archived home pages of 2026-05-19 and 2026-07-18 list no okrsky notice. 543004.name: Chynorany

543047.name: Klátova Nová Ves

543187.name: Jaklovce
543187.note: The referendum 2026 page holds the calling, information, e-mail address, data-protection note, minutes and results; no okrsky document. The municipal 2026 document (20.07.2026) is dated after the referendum and names only the polling stations.

543233.name: Kluknava
543233.note: The referendum 2026 page has only the call, voter information, delegation notice and the commissions' minutes; no utvorenie volebných okrskov. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

543322.name: Margecany

543519.name: Rudňany
543519.note: No document assigning houses to the two okrsky found. 543802.name: Streda nad Bodrogom

543951.name: Vojčice

544001.name: Zemplínska Nová Ves

544051.name: Vranov nad Topľou

544094.name: Bystré
